final_message:
I fixed the bug in `apply_op` in `src/rpn.py`. Subtraction was reversed: it returned `b - a` instead of `a - b`. So `evaluate("5 3 -")` gave `-2` instead of `2`. I haven't run any tests or the code after the change.

The other operators were already correct. Division and multiplication use the same operand order, so I left them alone.
